_doc: model-ab harness variants — the REBOOT axis (model × chat template × serve argv). Per-request axes (reasoning_effort, enable_thinking, sampling) are the probe matrix inside scripts/dev/model-ab.ts, so one boot covers them all. A variant whose model path is missing on disk is skipped with a note, so future outputs (heretic W8A8) can be pre-declared.

variants.name: w8a8-sideload
variants._why: The expected production config: official 3.8 W8A8 + the forced fixed template + the live gen flags.

variants.name: w8a8-mtp
variants._why: Same grafted W8A8 checkpoint WITH qwen3_next MTP speculative decoding on (method 'mtp'). Proves the grafted BF16 MTP head serves and shows the spec-decode timing vs w8a8-sideload. NOTE: min_p is ignored under spec-decode (harmless, we send min_p:0).

variants.name: w8a8-stock-template
variants._why: Same checkpoint, the checkpoint's OWN shipped template — renders the six defect classes live (probe errors here are FINDINGS, not harness failures).

variants.name: bf16-sideload
variants._why: The unquantized source as the quality ceiling — same template/flags, so any delta vs w8a8-sideload is the quantization.

variants.name: heretic-w8a8-sideload
variants._why: The future heretic quant (skipped until its SAVE_DIR exists).
